title: A joint resolution providing for the reappointment of John Fahey as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.
official_summary: This joint resolution reappoints John Fahey as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.

summary.headline: Congress approved reappointing John Fahey as a citizen regent of the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
summary.what_it_does: This joint resolution gives John Fahey another term as a citizen regent on the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. The Board of Regents oversees the Smithsonian, a group of museums, research centers, and the National Zoo. The summary does not describe any new duties, funding, or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 2, 2020.
